title: Toshiba inks deal to sell chip unit to Bain-Apple group for $18 billion
主要内容: Toshiba Corp agreed to sell its chip division for 2 trillion yen ($17.7 billion) to a Bain Capital-led consortium. The consortium includes Apple, Dell Technologies Capital, and SK Hynix. The sale aims to cover losses from Toshiba's bankrupt U.S. nuclear division. SK Hyn, will be "firewalled" from accessing TMC's proprietary information and will not own more than 15% of voting rights in Pangea or TMC for 10 years.
